diagnosis: Check C9 passed in all rollouts despite the decision-maker never having access to PF3. The model is defaulting to a 'policy_revision' commitment for security, customer support, and data science based on general caution or the presence of S4/S5, which triggers the requirement to withhold approval until revisions are complete, effectively satisfying C9 without knowing the specific 85% task success threshold.

C9.why: The draft uses adoption above 20% as its gate; PF3 changes the evaluation field to at least 85% task success on exactly 40 manually sampled review tasks, requires replacing the adoption criterion, and determines whether approval is withheld until that revision is complete.
